snippets.non_accrual: ff, MSC Income removes it from non-accrual status. Generally, any interest payments received from investments on non-accrual status reduce the cost basis of the investment and are not recorded as income. As of June 30, 2026, investments on non-accrual status were $ 26.7 million at fair value and $ 76.3 million at cost and comprised 1.9% and 5.8% of MSC Income’s total Investment Portfolio at fair value and cost, respectively.
